products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Manage your product inventory
products.pageHelp: This is your full product list. Use the search and filters to find a product, then tap the pencil to edit it. The copy icon starts a new product from an existing one. To change many prices or stock levels at once, use the "Bulk Price & Stock" page.
products.emptyNoProducts: No products yet. Click "Add Product" to create your first one.
products.emptyNoMatch: No products match your search or filters.
products.duplicateTooltip: Duplicate — start a new product from this one
products.packagingHintPrefix: Each size is sold separately. Pick one as the default (shown first / used for the "from" price). Enter prices
products.packagingHintSuffix: — this is the final amount the customer pays.
products.lowStockHint: Email the admin when this product's stock falls to or below this number. Default 5.
products.taxRateHintSuffix: — this rate only controls how that price is split on the invoice, never what the customer pays. Default 5; set 0 for exempt items like papad / papad katran.
products.hsnHint: The tariff heading this product is filed under. GSTR-1 Table 12 is an HSN-wise summary, and the tax rate above cannot stand in for it — 5% covers many different headings.
products.hsnCurrentRate: Current GST rate for this code:
products.hsnMismatchMiddle: but the published rate for {{code}} is
products.hsnMismatchSuffix: . That can be deliberate — but if it isn't, every sale of this product is filed at the wrong rate.
products.hsnBlankHint: Leave blank if you haven't decided. Sales of an unclassified product show up under "NOT CLASSIFIED" in the HSN summary, so the gap stays visible instead of quietly going missing.
products.homepageSectionsHint: Choose which homepage sections this product appears in.
products.noSections: No sections defined yet. Create sections in the Django admin first.
products.noGalleryImages: No gallery images. Click "Add Images" to upload.
products.needOneSize: Add at least one packaging size.
products.needWeight: Each size needs a weight greater than 0.
products.needPrice: Each size needs a price greater than 0.
products.discountTooHigh: Discounted price must be less than the price for every size.
products.imageRequiredBody: Please upload a product image for new products.
products.copyReadyBody: Details copied. Change the name, add photos, then save. The copy starts hidden.
products.galleryUploadFailed: Some gallery images failed to upload
